title: Flare flags.json
description: An app's feature flags. Each key matches a flag in the app's Cloudflare Flagship app; its type comes from its default.

default.description: The value until the server says otherwise, and whenever it can't (offline, flag missing). Pick the safe one.

live.description: Change at once, even on screen (kill switches). Otherwise a flag the app has read keeps its value until the app next comes to the foreground.

type.description: Only needed to make a whole-number default a fractional number.
